It is derived from the Arabic root 'm-t-s-l' which means to conform or to be in harmony with. The name Imtisal holds great spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, as it reflects the individual's commitment to surrender to God's will and to follow His guidance. Historically, this name has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify one's devotion and submission to Allah.
